settings.title: SYSTEM SETTINGS
settings.bootShieldDescription: The vault encrypts templates with Argon2id + mandatory Livencrypt layer + XChaCha20-Poly1305. The phrase and boxes are not stored in web storage.
settings.bootTemplateHelp: Must contain HEX characters 0-9 and a-f. The selected template is encrypted inside the vault.
settings.destructivePanicDescription: When enabled, the dashboard shows the ? button "Help to consult access". Pressing it overwrites best-effort and deletes vault, backups, templates and local Livencrypt user data.
settings.inactivityDescription: When enabled, any Livencrypt window closes the full application after the configured time without mouse movement, keyboard, scroll or interaction.
settings.networkHelp: By default Livencrypt does not cut the system network. Real profiles require typing ENTENDIDO.
settings.bootEnabledCloseText: The encrypted vault has been created and verified correctly. Livencrypt must close now to require the 5 boxes and phrase on next startup.
settings.bootEnabledMessage: Boot Shield enabled. Close Livencrypt to require encrypted access on next startup.

hardening.note: Hardening is applied when the process starts, not when the session is unlocked. Core dumps, dumpable and mlockall are attempted automatically at startup; integrity uses /etc/livencrypt/expected.sha256 or LIVENCRYPT_EXPECTED_SHA256.
